# Full development/test closure: every production dependency (see
# requirements.txt) plus the `dev` extra from pyproject.toml, plus this
# project itself (editable). Do not edit by hand: change pyproject.toml,
# then regenerate with:
#
#   pip install pip-tools
#   pip-compile --upgrade --extra=dev --output-file=requirements-dev.txt pyproject.toml
#
# pip-compile doesn't emit the leading `-e .` below — restore it by hand
# after regenerating (it's what makes `pip install -r
# requirements-dev.txt` also install this project itself).
#
# Generated with Python 3.14 — see requirements.txt's header comment for
# why, and the same caveat about python_version-conditional deps.
#
# CI installs this exact, pinned set (`pip install -r requirements-dev.txt`)
# for lint/type-check/test — not a fresh resolution of pyproject.toml's
# ranges — so what's tested is what was locked and audited.
